🚲 NEW START. BIG SHOOTOUT ENERGY. 💗

This Saturday, we’re trying something exciting. We’re rolling out immediately after the Co-Ed Shootout! (Old Man Group)

The Shootout is one of the largest weekly group rides in the country, and there’s something special about being surrounded by that many cyclists. Whether you already ride the main Shootout or have always been curious about it, this is a chance to experience the energy AND ride with a supportive community of women.

📍 NEW LOCATION: University & Euclid
For GPS: 845 E University
🕖 Old Man Group rolls at 7:35 a.m.
🕖 We roll at 7:37 a.m.

Please remember that we will not start from our usual MSA Annex/Mercado location. Street parking is available nearby, and there are usually plenty of spaces that early.

Look for our ride leader wearing a hot-pink mohawk on her helmet! We’ll offer A and B paces. Slower riders who are dropped may join the Old Old Man Group.

Men, you can help make this experiment a success! Please spread the word to the women in your cycling circles, and give our group a little extra space on the road, ideally drafting on us as little as possible so the women can rotate and take their pulls. We know it can be crowded, though!

We’re doing this with the permission of Fair Wheel Bikes. Thank you!!

If we enjoy the experience, University & Euclid will become our start location on the second Saturday of every month.

Come try something new with us and please help make sure nobody is waiting at the Mercado! 🚲💗

#WomensShootout #WomensCycling #WomenOnBikes #RoadCycling #TucsonAZ

What a colorful group! 🌈🚴‍♀️

One of our favorite things about the Women’s Shootout is the incredible women we get to ride alongside every Saturday!

Women of all ages, backgrounds, and cycling experiences come together to challenge themselves, push each other, and share a love of riding.

There’s something pretty inspiring about being surrounded by so many strong women and having a whole lot of fun along the way! 💪🧡

Want to join us? Next Saturday, we’ll be starting from University & Euclid, rolling out just after the “Old Man” group of the main Shootout!

Check out our Strava (link in bio) for ride details!

Who are we? 🚴‍♀️

We’re the Women’s Shootout (WSO), a women-only road cycling group founded by legendary triathlete Leanda Cave @leandacave and Pam Alexander!

📍 Based in Tucson, Arizona, we ride the world-famous Shootout route every Saturday. We’re a separate group from the co-ed Shootout rides and, while we ride with their blessing, we’re not affiliated with Fairwheel Bikes.

New Instagram, same great rides! 🎉

Follow along for ride announcements, photos, and all things WSO!

🧡 Want to ride with us? The best place to find our upcoming rides and event details is on Strava (link in bio)!
